relation_replay_kept.name: chiSquare_matches_weighted_residual_formula
relation_replay_kept.note: fires on the failing test's OWN input literals on the patched build (deterministic, 2/2 replays); fuzzed: 9241/20000
relation_replay_kept.why:
The fired check asserts the documented chi-square contract for a completed least-squares optimization—`getChiSquare()` must equal the sum of `weight[i] * (target[i] - optimum.getValueRef()[i])^2`—and no surviving counterexample from a correct implementation explains the large observed mismatch on this ordinary finite input.
CITATION: NONE
